user.title: Add a device
user.description: Create one entry per child PC or phone. Copy the generated API key into that device's agent — it is the only secret the agent needs. Points and the wake alarm follow this entry's child, not another device.

data_description.device_id: Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores only. Used in API URLs and must match the agent configuration.
data_description.device_name: Shown on the Home Assistant device and dashboards.
data_description.windows_username: The chore-manager child this device belongs to. Use that child's name. Each phone has its own device id and API key.
data_description.api_key: Auto-generated. Regenerating requires updating the agent on the device.

reconfigure.title: Rotate device API key
reconfigure.description: Generate a new API key for {device_name}. Copy it into the Windows or Android agent immediately; the previous key stops working as soon as you confirm.

data.confirm_rotate: I understand — rotate the API key now

error.invalid_device_id: Use only lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.
error.api_key_required: Enter or keep the generated API key.
error.api_key_too_weak: The API key must be at least 128 bits of random material (use the generated value).

abort.invalid_device_id: The device ID was empty after normalisation.
abort.reconfigure_successful: A new device API key was generated. Update the agent on the device before the old key stops working.

init.title: Parental Device Blocker options
init.description: Wake alarm, parent PIN override, screen assessment, and provider settings. The wake alarm is Android-only and is read on the phone's usual state poll. Volume is 0–100, where 100 is that phone's maximum alarm-stream volume. Leave a secret field blank to keep its saved value.

data.clear_screen_credentials: Clear saved VNC and Kilo credentials

data_description.wake_alarm_enabled: The person holding the phone can stop a ringing alarm. Changing the time, days, or volume is done here.
data_description.wake_alarm_volume: 0 is silent. 100 is the phone's maximum alarm-stream volume.
data_description.screen_schedule_mode: Manual creates only the Check screen now button. Fixed and random also run automatically.
data_description.kilo_base_url: Leave unchanged to use the documented Kilo Gateway default.
data_description.kilo_model: The official balanced automatic route is kilo-auto/balanced.
data_description.parent_pin: At least four characters. Used on the locked device for a one-hour override.

error.random_range: The maximum interval must be greater than or equal to the minimum.
error.invalid_provider_url: Enter a valid HTTPS base URL without credentials, a query, or a fragment.
error.parent_pin_too_short: Use a parent PIN with at least four characters.
error.required_when_enabled: This value is required when screen assessment is enabled.
error.invalid_wake_time: Enter a wake time as HH:MM.
error.wake_days_required: Choose at least one day when the wake alarm is on.
error.invalid_wake_volume: Alarm volume must be a whole number from 0 to 100.
